concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-transaction-clone]] — Control Panel transaction cloning with copied payment information, payment-method/Vault/status eligibility limits, the narrow fraud/risk rejection exception, amount/CVV entry, and authorization-only settlement selection
warnings: Keep this Control Panel workflow distinct from the server SDK/API clone operation.
Preserve the PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Venmo, Vault-origin, status, and role-permission boundaries; do not generalize the Fraud or Risk Threshold exception to other gateway rejections.
Reconcile the opening amount-only statement with the later CVV-if-applicable instruction, including the explicit no-CVV/no-check behavior.
Do not present authorization creation or settlement submission as final settlement or funding, and treat the 2026-09-16 snapshot as collected rather than current support evidence.
